# Leduc Receipt Pro

Leduc Receipt Pro is a receipt management application designed for Canadian contractors and small businesses. It provides AI-powered receipt scanning, CRA-compliant tax exports, and real-time financial insights.

## Core Features
- Receipt scanning and extraction
- CRA-compliant tax reporting (GST, HST, PST)
- Expense tracking and categorization
- Audit trail management
- Real-time financial insights
